query:
SELECT b.id, b.date, b.status, b.vessel_id, v.name as vessel_name, ac.email, ac.name as client_name
FROM bookings b
JOIN vessels v ON b.vessel_id = v.id
JOIN allowed_clients ac ON b.client_id = ac.id
WHERE b.date >= 1732752000000
ORDER BY b.date DESC
LIMIT 10;
